description: Capture a screenshot of any webpage as PNG or JPEG. Configurable viewport size, full-page mode, and image quality.

full_page.description: Capture the entire scrollable page (default: false)

height.description: Viewport height in pixels (default: 800, range: 200-2160). Ignored if full_page is true.

quality.description: JPEG quality (default: 80, range: 1-100). Only applies to JPEG format.

name: take_screenshot
